name: Teleprompter
description: Your notes, floating in front of you while you speak. Paste a script, then read it from your glasses — scrolling follows your voice or runs at a speed you set.

permissions.description: Used for voice-following auto-scroll — the teleprompter advances as you speak

hardwareRequirements.description: Renders your script on the glasses display while you present
Captures speech so scrolling can follow your voice; timed scrolling works without it

actions.description: Load text into the teleprompter and show it on the glasses, ready to read. Use when the user wants to put a speech, talking points, lines, or any notes up on their glasses — e.g. 'put my toast on the teleprompter' or 'teleprompt this'. Replaces the current script and resets to the top. Set autostart to begin scrolling immediately (it follows the user's voice when a mic is available, otherwise scrolls at their saved words-per-minute); leave it off to just show the opening lines so the user can start when ready.

script.description: The full script to display. Use blank lines to separate paragraphs; the teleprompter wraps each line to fit the glasses.

autostart.description: When true, start scrolling from the top right away. When false or omitted, load the script and show the opening lines without scrolling.
